meta.move: Skill: cites procedure 4.4 correctly after owning the call
meta.expect: Says 4.4 meets her fallback demand, flatly, wants it in writing; does NOT move to the last position on 4.4 alone; debrief Where she ended says whether that is the fair outcome

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's zero. Who decided it?
Before anything: I entered the zero before calling you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry.
Okay. What do you have on Owen's essay?

I want to read you section 4.4. For a first concern, the student may complete a supervised reassessment. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his record. This is a first concern.
That's 4.4, and nothing goes on his record. A rewrite for what, though? You haven't shown me one document.
I'll commit to that in writing tonight: nothing goes on his record.
Good. In writing tonight, and the zero comes off the gradebook until you can show me something.
So will you agree to the rewrite?
Not on nothing. Agreeing now would admit something Owen hasn't done. Show me what you have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

You agreed that nothing goes on Owen's record, and you said you would put that in writing tonight. I still require the zero removed from the gradebook and any evidence you have about the essay sent to me on paper. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her fallback position: you committed to keeping the record clean in writing, but she would not agree to the rewrite, and she still wants the zero off and your evidence shown. That is not yet the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4), and her time had not run out, so it was open for you to reach.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in a single sentence and moved on, which gave her a small sign of ground because it answered her complaint about process.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence, so she read taking it as admitting something and refused.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence at all, so you never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after owning the zero, put one dated document tied to Owen's own work on the table before you bring up 4.4, so the rewrite arrives as the answer to something she can check.
